subjects.description: Deformed, missing, duplicated or replaced vehicles; changed paint colors or truck tarpaulin colors; altered vehicle proportions, orientation, trajectories or relative distances; removed, enlarged, moving or reshaped original white ego-vehicle hood.
subjects.appearance_details: Repainted signs or lane markings, a white numeral replacing the original yellow 40, unreadable invented text, melted vehicle details, ghosting, excessive smoothing and artificial material textures.

background_setting: Changed road geometry, displaced lane boundaries, moving road markings, warped buildings, invented or missing objects, deep standing water, large-area flooding, an entirely flawless mirrored road without roughness or ripples, absent wet-surface reflections, uniformly matte dry-looking asphalt, snow, ice, dry dusty road, dense fog and whiteout.

aesthetics.color_scheme: Unnatural color casts, excessive saturation, crushed blacks, overexposure, globally washed-out colors, random brightness changes and changing vehicle colors.
aesthetics.patterns: Regular parallel rain lines, thick bright streaks, repeating particle textures, stationary airborne droplets, uniform screen-space rain overlays, full-frame blur, tiling and flickering road reflections.

temporal_caption: Flicker, object identity drift, abrupt weather changes, unstable road geometry, jumping lens droplets, splashes disconnected from tires, stationary spray despite vehicle motion, changing traffic signals and discontinuous camera motion.
physical_realism: Windshield wipers, invented windshield or cabin structures, large opaque optical droplets, lens-wide water smears, persistent obstruction of most of the view, exaggerated halos, uniform full-frame spray, physically impossible reflections, water flowing against gravity, deep flood waves, changed camera viewpoint and changed hood dimensions.
